sn23.16:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Dukkhadhammo dukkhadhammoti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante dukkhadhammoti || || Rūpaṃ kho bhante dukkhadhammo || vedanā dukkhadhammo saññā || saṅkhārā dukkhadhammo || viññāṇaṃ dukkhadhammo || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
